Intelligence Brief

We Read the Field
So You Can Move First

Lycos Intelligence specialises in public-source competitor research for local service businesses — from gyms and med spas to landscapers, coaches, real estate agents, and beyond.

"We help businesses understand competitors, identify reputation gaps, expose online weaknesses, and surface the opportunities their market has left unguarded."

◆ ◇ ◆

Everything is sourced from legally public information — Google, reviews, social media, directories, filings. No spying. No grey areas. Just sharp, actionable intelligence.

Operations

What We Do

01 — PRIMARY

Competitor Intelligence

Deep public-source research on your top competitors — their offers, pricing signals, online footprint, and weak points.

02 — RESEARCH

Market Research

Sector-level data collection on local market dynamics, demand signals, and positioning opportunities.

03 — AUDIT

Online Presence Audit

Website, listings, social media — we map the full picture and score it against competitors in your space.

04 — REPUTATION

Review & Reputation Analysis

Pattern-level reading of Google and Yelp reviews to identify trust gaps and sentiment exploitation opportunities.

05 — LEADS

Lead Research Lists

Targeted prospect lists built from public directories, verified and formatted for immediate outreach.

06 — MONITORING

Monthly Intelligence Watch

Ongoing competitor and reputation monitoring delivered as a monthly intelligence update report.
